verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Zero's MCP tools can delete or bulk-delete emails, and that Zero can be self-hosted. It also states Zero stores users' emails in Durable Objects and R2. However, nothing documents retention settings, purging of cached or stored data, or account and data deletion controls. Deleting mailbox emails is an adjacent email-management feature, and self-hosting or Drizzle Studio are deployment and developer building blocks, so neither delivers privacy-oriented retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
